description: Dependency updates through the Mend Renovate app (ADR-0012, ADR-0017). Weekly pull requests grouped by area; majors and Expo SDK packages separately.

packageRules.description: Every update is a chore without a scope: commitlint allows only workspace folder names as scopes, and dependency updates do not go into the release notes. Overrides the fix type that config:recommended gives to dependencies.
Web app: one weekly pull request for minor and patch updates.
Mobile app: one weekly pull request for minor and patch updates (Expo SDK packages are handled below).
Tooling: root package.json (including packageManager), shared config and domain packages, the pnpm catalog and the Node.js version.
GitHub Actions and container images in workflows, pinned by digest with the version in a comment.

GHCR gives no release timestamps, so Renovate cannot apply the 3-day release age to the gitleaks image and would hold its updates forever. Instead the update waits for approval in the Dependency Dashboard: approve it once the new image digest (not only the release) is at least 3 days old.
prBodyNotes: Approved by hand because GHCR has no release dates: the new digest in this pull request must have been published at least 3 days ago. An old release can get a newly pushed digest, so check the digest itself on the [GHCR versions page](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/pkgs/container/gitleaks/versions?filters%5Bversion_type%5D=tagged) ("Published ... · Digest"). After the merge, update the local pre-commit gitleaks (`brew upgrade gitleaks`).

packageRules.description: The Expo SDK decides these versions; React must match the exact version its React Native requires. Upgrade them together with `expo install --fix` after approving them in the Dependency Dashboard.
TypeScript stays on 6.x until typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7.
